conviction_note: FY2026 was pre-released on 2026-09-25 (OP 875m, net 785m including about 240m of deferred-tax gain), so the print turns on the first FY2027 guide and the dividend. The mid-term plan's roughly 30% profit path implies FY27 net of about 680-720m, below the deferred-tax-inflated 785m, so kabutan's net-income headline (the line it uses for this name) probably reads as a decline. This holder base paid +15.5% for that same headline on 09-28 and then gave all of it back. A likely dividend raise under the plan's 20%+ payout floor partly offsets it. abs_move is raised from the 4.7 proxy to 6.0 because this is a full-year print with a new guide. p_up 46 is only a slight lean, because none of this is a hard number: the findings sum to -1.7 and the scaled number is -0.48. The gap between them is the uncertainty about the guide's sign, which belongs in p_up.
bar: FY2026: the company's own revised forecast of 2026-09-25 (revenue 12,878m, OP 875m, pretax 763m, net 785m, EPS 61.59), https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260925/140120260925539974.pdf. The IFIS consensus is stale and sits above it (OP 900, pretax 800, net 550; https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=428A). FY2027: no 四季報 or IFIS number was found. The only bar is the mid-term plan of 2026-08-19 (CAGR about 25% revenue and about 30% OP/net, from an FY26 budget of OP 850 and net 520), which implies FY27 OP of about 1,100-1,140m and net of about 680-720m. https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260819/140120260819523056.pdf. The FY27 bar is the company's own plan path, not a street number, so the guidance findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline). The stock is a buy-only 制度信用 name (kabutan: 買建のみ), so no margin short exists. Margin long balance (kabutan, weekly): 301.9k shares on 09-04, 305.0k on 09-11, 318.8k on 09-18, 324.2k on 09-25 and 322.6k on 10-02. That is about 2.5% of the 12.8m shares and roughly 10 days of the 20-day median volume (about 30k shares a day at ¥52m), so leveraged retail is crowded long with no short fuel. No option skew exists. Run-up: +10.6% over 20 days, -4.0% over 5 days, and -12% from the 09-29 post-revision high of 1,934 to the 10-06 close of 1,704. Spot is up 3% intraday at the 10:05 seal. Source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=428A

findings.finding: The first FY2027 guide will very likely show net income falling from FY26's 785m, which was lifted by about 240m of deferred-tax gain. The mid-term plan's ~30% path implies about 680-720m. kabutan's auto-headline for this name runs on 最終 (net income), e.g. '今期最終は19％増で4期連続最高益' at the FY25 print, so the first guide headline most likely reads as a net-income decline that breaks the record-profit streak, even though OP keeps growing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The net-income headline is what this register trades. On 2026-09-25 the revision raised OP only 2.9% (850 to 875) but net 51% via the deferred-tax gain. The stock rose +15.51% on 09-28, then fell from 1,934 to 1,704 over five sessions. The FY25 print (first guide, '最高益', 10円 初配当) rose +6.31% and +7.27% on the next two sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: The deferred-tax nature of the FY26 net beat is public, but there is no FY27 consensus anywhere (IFIS shows FY26 only), so nobody has published the FY27 net number this headline will be compared with. If the market had priced a net-income decline headline, the post-revision pop would not have depended on the net line, and the margin long balance would not have kept rising into the print (301.9k to 322.6k shares).
findings.independence: The mid-term plan document (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260819/140120260819523056.pdf, net 520m to about 1,100m at ~30% CAGR) and the revision PDF (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260925/140120260925539974.pdf, 法人税等調整額 about 2.4億円) are separate primary documents. Together they establish the arithmetic. The reaction claim rests on the kabutan price history alone.

findings.finding: The mid-term plan sets a payout floor of 20%+ (配当性向20%以上). The FY26 year-end dividend is still planned at 10円, which is 16% of the revised EPS of 61.59円 (it was not revised on 09-25). That leaves room for a FY26 raise to at least about 12円 and/or a FY27 dividend guide above 10円 at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY25 print, where the first dividend (10円) and the 優待 introduction came out in the same batch, rose +6.3% and +7.3% over the next two sessions. Publication of the 優待 contents on 2025-12-15 was reported as a '刺激材料' (kabutan 2025-12-17).
findings.why_not_priced: The yield is 0.57% on 10円, and no source mentions a dividend increase. The 09-25 revision left the dividend untouched, so the market saw no change. Even so, a 2-4円 raise is worth little in yield terms, and only a headline reaction would make it matter.
findings.independence: The Q3 短信 confirms the 10円 forecast was unrevised: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591029.pdf

findings.finding: Q4 FY26 implied OP is about 286m (875 - 589 nine-month), up only about 6% YoY on revenue up about 12%. The quarter's margin is about 8.1% against about 8.6% a year earlier, as 18 openings ate margin. FY27 plans 30 openings (22 already confirmed per the 2026-10-05 月次), which risks a first-year OP guide below the plan's ~30% path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The mid-term plan release (2026-08-19, the 30-store and 30% CAGR path) was followed by -3.17% on 08-20, read as 利益確定. Margin-line surprises have no history at prior quarters (Q1 -2.74%, Q2 -0.56%, Q3 +1.32% on the release days).
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced: anyone can compute the Q4 margin from the revision and the Q3 短信, and the plan was drawn up on 08-19 with Q4 almost complete. The open question is whether the first-year guide is back-end loaded. The stock fell 2.36% on the 10-05 月次 day (existing-store customers -2.3%), so some of it is in the price.
findings.independence: Q3 短信 nine-month OP 589m: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591029.pdf (a different document from the 月次). Both feed one arithmetic, so this is filed as one finding.

findings.finding: Margin long balance of 322.6k shares (about 10 days of volume) with zero short of any kind, after a -12% fade from the post-revision high. Leveraged holders are crowded long into the print, so a disappointing guide has forced sellers and nothing offsets them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 09-28 spike the stock gave back the whole move over five sessions (+15.5%, then +3.5, -5.5, +2.4, -4.8, -2.4, -2.0), consistent with leveraged holders selling into strength.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance is visible, so this is a modifier, not hidden information. It matters only in the disappointing branch, which is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: The baseline's JPX short register (0.0%, as of 2026-09-29) independently confirms there is no short side.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in line with the -0.53 priced lean and the -4% 5-day fade, so they partly agree with what is already priced. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY27 OP guide at or above 30% growth on the 875m actual (about 1,140m) together with a 増配. I looked for both and found no source either way beyond the plan's payout floor, which is why p_up sits at 46 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the Q4-margin/opening-cost finding uses arithmetic anyone can do from the revision and the Q3 短信, plus the public 月次, so it was cut from -0.5 to -0.2, and p_up moved from 45 to 46.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I checked the strongest positive (a 増配 under the 20% payout floor, and a guide at or above the plan path); the dividend was already filed as a positive and I had looked for it, so no further change.
Open question 3 (a pre-released period): already reflected in the draft, where FY26 lines carry no finding; left standing.
